name: Linkomize
author: Bermikod Plugins

sections.description:
Linkomize is a powerful and lightweight WordPress plugin that allows you to generate custom tracking links for your advertising campaigns and monitor user activity in real-time. Whether you’re running Facebook Ads, Google Ads, or any other source, this plugin helps you track conversions, clicks, add-to-cart events, and more — all from a clean and simple admin interface.

Built by BermikodPlugins, this plugin is ideal for marketers, advertisers, and WooCommerce store owners who want to measure the effectiveness of their campaigns with minimal setup.

🎯 Key Features:

  • Create custom tracking links for Facebook, Google Ads, Instagram, etc.
  • Real-time click and conversion monitoring
  • Track add-to-cart and purchase events
  • Visual admin dashboard with performance summary
  • Easy-to-use interface — no coding required
  • Compatible with WooCommerce
  • Lightweight and performance-optimized

This plugin gives you full control over how traffic is coming to your site and what users are doing, enabling you to make better ad decisions based on real data.

Credits

Developed by BermikodPlugins
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file or install directly from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  4. Access the “Linkomize” panel from your WordPress admin sidebar.
  5. Start creating tracking templates and monitor user behavior.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce?

Yes. It works seamlessly with WooCommerce for tracking product-related events like add-to-cart and purchases.

Can I use this for Facebook and Google Ads?

Absolutely. You can create links for both platforms and analyze their performance separately.

Does this plugin store any user data?

No personal data is stored. The plugin tracks anonymous session data for statistical analysis only.
